## Summary

The story of 'The Sleeping Beauty in the Wood' narrates the tale of a princess cursed by an uninvited fairy to fall into a deep sleep for a hundred years, only to be awakened by a prince. The narrative explores themes of love, fate, and the consequences of envy, culminating in the eventual triumph of love over adversity. The tale also includes elements of magic, such as fairies and enchanted objects, and addresses the darker aspects of human nature through the character of the ogress queen.
